node.statement: For E_[1,j-1]=sum_{r<j}Pi_r and Pi_j, exact source orthogonality and delta-multiplicativity give ||P_[1,j-1]P_j||<=delta; star preservation gives the reverse-product bound. Linearity gives P_[1,j]=P_[1,j-1]+P_j and P_[1,p]=v(I_B). The identical argument gives all Q relations.
